nodes.name: pkgdown.yaml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds the hoopR pkgdown documentation site on pushes to main/master (or manual dispatch) and deploys it via pkgdown::deploy_to_branch, installing SportsDataverse companion packages and KenPom (KP_USER/KP_PW) credentials needed to render vignettes.
nodes.languageNotes: Single ubuntu-latest R-release job using r-lib/actions; concurrency group cancels in-progress runs; needs contents:write permission to push the built site.

nodes.name: R-CMD-check.yaml
nodes.summary: Primary CI workflow running R CMD check across a macOS/Windows/Ubuntu matrix (R release) on push, pull request, and a weekly Friday cron, with optional live-API test toggles (NBA Stats, NBA G-League, ESPN, NCAA MBB) supplied via secrets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses r-lib/actions setup-r + check-r-package with upload-snapshots; live tests still short-circuit on skip_on_ci() unless the *_TESTS secrets enable them.

nodes.name: rhub.yaml
nodes.summary: Manually-dispatched R-hub v2 workflow that fans out R CMD check across user-selected R-hub platforms (linux containers + windows/macos) for CRAN-submission validation, with a setup job emitting the platform/container matrix consumed by the downstream check jobs.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical r-hub/actions template: workflow_dispatch-only with a setup job whose JSON outputs drive matrix strategies; requires an RHUB_TOKEN plus the same KenPom + live-API secrets as the other workflows.
